{{Quote|Or is it the ways of darkness and shadow you seek, the power that comes from striking unseen and sensing weaknesses in your enemies&hellip;? The ways of the assassins of the Sith.|Kreia|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
'''Sith assassins''' was a title held by some [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] who served the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]], specializing in stealth and dealing high amounts of damage to enemies in melee combat. They were known to primarily wield [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|saberstaffs]] in combat, and some were adept at [[Force stealth|concealing]] themselves with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Equipment and methods==
{{Quote|The sect of assassins that chase you feed on the Force&hellip; what he does is simply the pinnacle of what they could achieve, in time. And that is why they&mdash;and their techniques&mdash;must be wiped out.|Kreia, to [[Meetra Surik]], on [[Darth Nihilus]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] assassins were unique because they preferred to ambush their intended prey from the shadows rather than engaging them in open combat. Almost always working solo or in small groups, they utilized [[Stealth field generator/Legends|Stealth field generators]] and the rare [[Force power/Legends|art]] of [[Force cloak|Force camouflage]] to aid their surprise attacks. While some elite assassins fought with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], the majority utilized less remarkable melee weapons, such as [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]]. These stealth warriors were also unusual in that they drew their power from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] presence of their prey. The stronger their targets were in the Force, the stronger the hunters became.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />

==History==
[[File:Sith_Assassin.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Sith assassin of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] studies a hologram of his [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|target]].]]
{{Quote|It is a different war these Sith wage, a thing of silence and shadow. They strike from the darkness, hiding from the face of the galaxy, until all Jedi are exterminated. After all the Jedi are gone, then the galaxy is theirs, no matter whether the Sith or the Republic rules&hellip; it is the dark side that shall reign, unchecked. I believe them to be the result of&hellip; special teachings. [&hellip;] Those Sith assassins can sense their prey through the Force&mdash;it is like a hunger. They feed&hellip; and grow stronger&hellip; when they are near Force Sensitives. The stronger their prey is in the Force, the deadlier they become.|Kreia, on the assassins of the [[Sith Triumvirate]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" />}}
During and after the [[Jedi Civil War]], the assassins' primary purpose was to kill or capture [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Upon successfully incapacitating a Jedi, the captive would be [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] until they fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] or died by the hands of elite Sith operatives trained in the art of torture and temptation, such as [[Atton Rand]]. By this subtle method of capture and conversion, the ranks of the Sith assassins swelled as the number of Jedi decreased.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" /><ref name="Chronicles of the Old Republic">{{LucasArts|url=games/swkotor_sithlords|text=''Chronicles of the Old Republic''|int=Chronicles of the Old Republic}}</ref>

[[File:MiravsSithAssassin.jpg|thumb|235x235px|Mira fighting a Sith assassin.]]
The Sith Assassins reached their zenith under the [[Sith Triumvirate|leadership]] of [[Kreia|Darth Traya]], [[Darth Sion]], and [[Darth Nihilus]] following the almost complete annihilation of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire's]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] during the [[Sith Civil War]]. Based within the hidden [[Trayus Academy]] on Malachor V, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] commanded legions of Assassins to [[First Jedi Purge|hunt down]] the remaining Jedi throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Their efforts proved quite successful as they very nearly caused the complete extermination of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords" /><ref name="Chronicles of the Old Republic" />

During the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Sith assassins were employed by the returned [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="FanFriday" />

During the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] [[Sith training|trained]] Sith assassins in the [[Sith Academy (Ryloth)|Ryloth Academy]], [[Sith Academy (Umbara)|Umbara Academy]], and [[Sith Academy (Nar Shaddaa)|Nar Shaddaa Academy]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction" /> At least eight of the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] Sith assassins survived the [[New Sith Wars]], and joined [[Hetton]]'s [[Anti-Republic Liberation Front]]. However, they were all killed by Darth [[Darth Bane/Legends|Bane]] during a duel when they were brought to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Zannah]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> The [[One Sith]] incorporated an agency called [[Sith Intelligence and Assassination]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', Sith assassin is one of the six prestige character classes which the main character can select after reaching level 15. Like its [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] counterpart, [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]], this class corresponds to the [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]] non-prestige class. All the in-game Sith assassins have this character class. Jedi Watchman and Sith Assassin, unlike the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]/[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Jedi Weapon Master]]/[[Sith Marauder]] counterparts, are not "one for one" ability trades. Sith Assassin has a lower feat and save progression, but gains more sneak attack dice.

When you enter the [[Trayus Academy]], an assassin appears with two lightsabers; a normal one, and a short-bladed. This is the one of the two elite Sith assassins. An elite Sith assassin appears on Citadel Station wielding a double-bladed lightsaber during the battle of Telos IV in KotOR II.

The Sith Assassins in KotOR II wear masks that have striking aesthetic similarities to the mask worn by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] (without the helmet).

The Sith Assassin is an advanced class for the Sith Inquisitor class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in the use of the double-bladed lightsaber, stealth, and dealing bursts of damage in battle. They can also be able to tank, using Force Powers and Lightsaber skills to protect allies and members of the Empire and themselves. The Republic counterpart for this archetype is the [[Jedi Shadow]].<ref name="FanFriday" />
